classification: Regression introduced by the Objective-C-to-Swift migration.
evidence: The preceding Objective-C bridge forwards scalar null and mixed null/string maps. The migration introduced `as? NSString` and `as? [String: String]` guards, rejecting both. Historical execution reproduces both rejections while empty-string controls pass. The parent already documented null display-name deletion and typed attribute values as `string | null`; its pinned PHC 1.10.0 normalized nulls. The change also appears in prerelease tag `3.0.0-rc.1`.
limitations: Historical bridge methods executed with recording dependency shims. Parent shared-library normalization was source-checked, not run through a complete historical app or server.
